next_action.rationale: apply_slot_correction was approved and applied last round for the affected carrier feed. Now in the CORRECTING phase, the highest-information step is to verify the effect of the applied correction: count how many EXC-0921 orders remain stuck in 'allocated, awaiting pickup'. This both checks whether the mitigation actually resolved the stalled cohort (versus only partially or not at all) and produces the impact_estimate the checklist still flags as missing, since proxy support-contact counts cannot substitute for an actual stranded-order count.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Post-mitigation stranded-order count, confirming whether the slot correction fixed the confirmation-vs-slot-window mismatch identified in C6 or whether the fix was insufficient and further correction (e.g., replay_held_allocations or escalation) is needed.
